subject: info-f
title: INF.F.-----RT.DY.
description: Diagram closing R(AS)CM(II)-19, the section on advertising and the present-day machinery of music promotion. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'I find it amazing that there is an audience for classical and creative (let alone "world") music at all — not that there isn't any advertising for alternative forms to some degree, but the composite thrust of present-day machinery for popular music is almost overwhelming. The seriousness of what this phenomenon means is not separate from the reality realness of creative music.' The crossing diagrams what information-focus actually meets when the machinery of advertising is the working partner: INFO-F (information focus) is crossed with RT-DY (reality dynamics — what the advertising machinery treats as actually-real for the receiving public). INFO-F sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-right to RT-DY. Three lines leave the main line: one rises to CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis) at the upper right, with ACT (activism) branching from it; one drops straight down to PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), with GRAD (gradualism) branching from it and STF (source transfer) branching in turn from GRAD; and one runs down-right to AF-NT (affinity nature), with CN-INFO (controlled information) branching from it to the right.
